# Placeholder textures & frames

Replace these SVG files with your real artwork **keeping the same filenames**
(or update CSS vars in `src/styles/egyptian-polish.css`).

## textures/
| File | Purpose | Suggested real asset |
|------|---------|----------------------|
| panel-dark.svg | Card/panel fill | panel-dark.webp |
| red-leather.svg | Primary buttons | red-leather.webp |
| paper-noise.svg | Global wear overlay | paper-noise.webp |
| stone-sidebar.svg | Sidebar grain | stone-sidebar.webp |
| teal-marble.svg | Flexible pool | teal-marble.webp |
| crimson-leather.svg | Locked pool | crimson-leather.webp |
| gold-vignette.svg | Page vignette | gold-vignette.webp |
| gold-dust.svg | Floating particles | gold-dust.webp (sparse) |

## frames/
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| panel-corner.svg | Corner ornaments on papers |
| panel-frame-top.svg | Top edge of panels |
| panel-frame-bottom.svg | Bottom edge |
| panel-frame-left.svg / right.svg | Side rails (available) |
| separator-diamond.svg | Divider motif |

Your existing Forbidden Oasis brand/hero/vault art goes back under the
paths already referenced by App.tsx (logo, hero, vault, pools, etc.).
